scenario_description:
Objective: Keep city battery-tool kits usable for Tuesday's riverbank cleanup without changing the volunteer plan or spending personal money.
Emerging Need: A freeze forecast appears before the battery totes' overnight location is confirmed; once they are reported in an unheated shed, preventable cold exposure becomes a credible risk.
Decision Context: Stored tool-care notes identify the no-cost internal handling route, limits on volunteer workarounds, and the afternoon cutoff for reversible storage changes.
Consequence: Timely coordination can keep the kits within safe storage before lockup; after the shed closes, the cleanup may face failed batteries or delayed crews in the morning.

parameter.title: Riverbank leaf-clearing crew
parameter.description: Volunteer cleanup along the east river path; parks kit reservation includes rakes, two battery-tool totes, and bag carts.

parameter.subject: Freeze watch for Riverton river corridor tonight
parameter.body: The evening update now forecasts temperatures falling below freezing near the river corridor from 23:00 Monday through 07:00 Tuesday, with pockets around 28°F before sunrise.

parameter.content: Staging note for tomorrow's east path cleanup: rakes, bag carts, and both battery-tool totes are being placed in unheated Shed C this afternoon so the gate volunteer can open at 07:50.

parameter.subject: Shed C closing round posted for Monday
parameter.body: Facilities has posted the Monday closing round for Shed C: storage carts roll to the maintenance bay at 16:50, and no shelf or cart changes will be accepted after the closing round starts.

parameter.content: Shed C is locked for the night now. The rakes, carts, and battery-tool totes are inside, and no parks staff are scheduled back at the site before the morning gate opening.

We opened Shed C after the freezing night. Both battery totes remained in the unheated shed throughout the cold period; the first tool test is showing reduced charge. We can still plan a safer cleanup, but the overnight cold exposure has already happened.
